name: Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate
description: Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate (CAS 222721-94-0 ) is a citric acid triester derived from C14–C15 fatty alcohols, functioning as an emollient, plasticizer, and emulsifier across personal care and industrial formulations. Its ester structure positions it as a bio-based alternative to synthetic plasticizers in applications where regulatory or sustainability criteria influence sourcing decisions for modern manufacturing. In personal care, it acts as a skin-conditioning emollient and emulsifier in creams, lotions, and color cosmetics, contributing to texture and spreadability without a heavy feel for the end user. Formulators in coatings and adhesives use it as a plasticizer to improve flexibility and film formation in polymer systems. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it supports emulsification. This chemical supports the emulsification of oils and actives within surfactant-based systems. Food-contact and packaging applications may also draw on its citrate ester chemistry where compliant options are required. Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate is typically supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the distinct purity requirements of various uses. The product is manufactured to meet high quality standards for personal care versus industrial end uses.
